text: The westbound curb lane on Queens Quay East, east of Yonge Street currently operates as a combined through and right-turn lane. However, motorists cannot proceed through the intersection from this lane as the curb lane west of Yonge Street is currently occupied by a designated Motorcoach Loading Zone, delineated by signage and hatched pavement markings. Under the current lane designation, drivers using the westbound curb lane on Queens Quay East at Yonge Street to proceed through the intersection, must abruptly change lanes to merge back into the westbound through lane due to the Motorcoach Loading Zone present west of Yonge Street. This causes driver confusion, resulting in abrupt lane changes and increasing the potential for vehicular conflicts at this intersection. City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate the northerly curb lane on Queens Quay East, from Yonge Street to a point 30.5 metres east, for westbound right turns only, buses excepted.
